__doc__: Type map for fastino/gliner2-privacy-filter-PII-multi (42 types) onto the
Unmapped types are DROPPED, each for a recorded reason (below) — mapping a
fragment (a bare city, a CVV, a transaction date) onto a broader category
would make the emitted extent lie, the same call as the rejected DE_PLZ /
COVERAGE FACT that frames the whole experiment: this model has NO type for
Organization, MedicalCondition, Medication, HealthInsuranceNumber or URL.
A full swap therefore zeroes the frozen control group and auto-REJECTs on
decision rule #1. The measurement decides whether it earns a place as an
ADDITIONAL recall arm (phones, national IDs, contact data) instead.

dropped.city: address fragment — a bare city as Address makes the extent lie (DE_PLZ precedent)
dropped.postal_code: address fragment — same call as the rejected UK-postcode port
dropped.country: address fragment, and a country name alone is rarely PII
dropped.card_expiry: no canonical category; as CreditCardNumber the extent would lie
dropped.card_cvv: no canonical category; same — revisit only with a new category ticket
dropped.username: no canonical category; as Person it would flag every handle
dropped.account_id: any opaque id — pure FP generator against 21-category semantics
dropped.sensitive_date: not DateOfBirth — mapping it would flag ordinary dates

notes.USSocialSecurityNumber: no dedicated type; SSNs surface via government_id/national_id_number and map to NationalIdentificationNumber — the regex tier keeps the USSSN label via arbitration
notes.URL: no type at all — URL stays with the regex tier / current model
notes.control_group_gap: Organization, MedicalCondition, Medication have no type — see __doc__
